title: Where the family lived in the Seventh Ward
summary: He gives the addresses where he and his Marrero and Barnes relatives lived downtown.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Well I forgot to ask about your family, what part of town were they, did they live in?

Of all our life, that's easy, I was born 1123 Two Row Street. That's between Murray and St. Claude. Left from there we went in the next block, 1223 Two Row Street. And I stood there until I got married, January 31st, 1923.
Did most of the Mareros and Barnes and all of them live around that neighborhood too?

The Mareros lived on, in the 1100 block, I was, we was 23, there was 25, the Mareros lived next to them. John, Salmon, that's when their father was living, Billy Moran. And the Barnes at that time was living, let's see now, the Barnes at that time was living on, I believe on Spain and Ville. Yeah, my old aunt Katrine, that's Milla's mother.
But all downtown in that... All downtown in that...

All downtown. Never did go otherwise out to the 7th or the 8th Ward. Just living that bondage between the 7th and the 8th Ward. All of our lives, from the 7th Ward to the 8th Ward. One time the Mareros was living back on Maroney Street between Johnson and Galvis. Another time the bonds was living on Maroney and Oikwalt, that's the 8th Ward. And the Mareros was living on Spain between Ville and that was the 8th, that consisted of the 8th Ward. Yeah. Me, I was living all my days in the 7th Ward. Never was out of it. From Two Row Street to the boundary of Seminard, Ville, around the old alley. I lived in that neighborhood for years and years. Seminard between Ville and Robinson. And that's the funniest I ever lived back where we're living right now. But I always lived in the 7th Ward.
